listed_sector_signals.signal: Pulp and paper industry mentioned only in a cited reference title, not as the paper's application context
listed_sector_signals.quote:
The role of environmental regulation in the future
competitiveness of the pulp and paper industry: The case of the sulfur emissions directive in Northern
Europe.

one_line: The paper proposes and validates a methodology for integrating an ISO 50001 energy management system into an existing ISO 14001 environmental management system, applied in a discrete-manufacturing automotive-sector company in Mexico.
